about.missionText:
My mission — to help you become
confident in your financial decisions
about.workWith1: Beginners who want to understand the fundamentals of investing.
about.workWith2: Experienced investors seeking stability and growth.
about.workWith3: Entrepreneurs who want to preserve and multiply their capital.
about.aiHelp: Our AI will help you choose a course in minutes
about.eduardPath2: I had this movie in my head: me with a laptop on the beach, a cocktail in one hand, a green PnL in the other — and somewhere in the background, the ocean and freedom.
about.realityItem2: the constant chase of 'just one more indicator and it'll work'
about.realityItem3: a marathon of video lessons, tests, and fake 'gurus'
about.realityItem4: and the final stage — a complete reset of myself as a trader
about.eduardStudied: I studied the market, wore down my knuckles on flat price action, broke my head over price psychology — and at some point, it all clicked.
about.eduardNowStable: For a significant time now, my trading has been consistently in the green — no panic, no chasing losses.
about.eduardFoundation1: And all of this became the foundation for launching the project
about.pantheonXItem4: breaking down market maker manipulations so you don't become their victim
about.finalCta1: So, if you're tired of guessing —
about.finalCta2: slow down and become part of PantheonX
about.finalCta3: and let's finally trade with our heads, not our emotions

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how PantheonX (hereinafter referred to as the 'Platform', 'we', 'us', or 'our') collects, uses, stores, and protects the personal data of users (hereinafter referred to as the 'User', 'you') when using the website, educational services, screener, trading tools, and other Platform services. By using the Platform, you agree to the terms of this Policy.
privacy.section1Intro: We may collect the following categories of data:
privacy.section1Text1: email address and password (encrypted) that you provide during registration and login.
privacy.section1Text2: first name, last name, phone number, Solana wallet address (optional, for receiving NFT certificates).
privacy.section1Text3: information about purchased subscriptions and payment status. Payment card details are processed exclusively by payment providers and are not stored by us.
privacy.section1Text4: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, device identifiers, access date and time, and data about your interaction with the Platform.
privacy.section1Text5: course progress, results, earned certificates, and webinar participation.
privacy.section2Item2: provide access to educational materials, screener, trading bots, and other Platform features;
privacy.section2Item3: process subscriptions, payments, and issue certificates;
privacy.section2Item4: provide technical support and respond to your requests;
privacy.section2Item5: improve the Platform's performance, analyze its usage, and ensure security;
privacy.section2Item6: send important service notifications, and with your consent — informational and marketing communications.
privacy.section3Body: We process personal data on the basis of: contract performance (providing Platform services), your consent (e.g., for marketing communications), compliance with legal obligations, and our legitimate interests in ensuring security and improving the service.
privacy.section4Body: The Platform uses cookies and similar technologies for authentication, saving your settings, traffic analysis, and improving user experience. You can manage cookies in your browser settings, but disabling certain cookies may limit Platform functionality.
privacy.section5Intro: We do not sell your personal data. Data may only be shared with:
privacy.section5Item1: service providers who assist us in operating the Platform (hosting, analytics, payment systems, email services), within the scope necessary for their functions;
privacy.section5Item2: government authorities — in cases provided for by applicable law;
privacy.section5Item3: in the event of reorganization, merger, or sale of the business — with the successor in compliance with this Policy.
privacy.section6Body: We apply organizational and technical security measures, including password encryption, access restrictions, and secure data transmission channels. Personal data is stored for the duration of your account and the time necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, or as required by law. No method of data transmission or storage is absolutely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.section7Item1: access your personal data and obtain a copy;
privacy.section7Item3: delete your account and associated data (via the 'Settings' page or by contacting support);
privacy.section7Item4: restrict processing or object to it;
privacy.section7Item6: file a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.
privacy.section8Body: The Platform is not intended for persons under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you believe a minor has provided us with their data, please contact us for deletion.
privacy.section9Body: We may periodically update this Privacy Policy. The current version is always available on this page with the date of the last update. By continuing to use the Platform after changes are made, you accept the updated Policy.
privacy.section10Body: For questions about the processing of personal data or exercising your rights, you may contact us at:

tradingChat.expertBadge: For those already in the market — from Igor Porokh and a team of trading practitioners with a combined 15+ years of experience
tradingChat.title: «Trading Chat»
tradingChat.subtitle: A channel where decisions are made with data, scenarios, and analysis — not emotions and news.
tradingChat.forWho1: want to see how practitioners work: market analysis, scenarios, decisions, risk management.
tradingChat.forWho2: are familiar with spot / futures / exchanges / TradingView and want more clarity in their actions.
tradingChat.forWho3: are building a clear process: what to do, when to do it, and why.
tradingChat.learnMoreTitle: Find out what's in the chat:
tradingChat.feature1: Live trading and analysis from us and our partner (10+ years of experience) and trader partners and practitioners
tradingChat.feature2: Current market situation breakdown without hype and emotions
tradingChat.feature3: Insights on trades, scenarios, and decision logic
tradingChat.feature4: Training on the current trading strategy for 2026 (available exclusively in the chat)
tradingChat.feature5: Opportunity to be the first to test our analytical screener
tradingChat.resultsTitle: Results after being in the chat:
tradingChat.result1: Less uncertainty and wavering from news and others' opinions
tradingChat.result2: Clearer understanding of what's happening in the market right now
tradingChat.result4: Calmer decisions: when to act, when to wait, when not to enter
tradingChat.result5: Discipline in action: fewer impulsive trades, more controlled steps
tradingChat.result6: A more stable workflow: analysis → plan → action → review
